leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a two-dimensional array structure to represent the game board state
Implement methods to update individual cell values within the board matrix
Configure TypeScript interfaces to define the shape of board state data
Apply array manipulation techniques to modify board contents programmatically
Bind board state data to Angular template elements for visual display
Construct helper functions to validate and control board state transitions
Integrate board state management with Angular component lifecycle methods
Render dynamic board layouts based on current state values
